definition_used: Statement by journal, publisher, company, institution, government agency or author that one or more authors committed misconduct.
caution: Misconduct is a broad term that can affect any aspect of the manuscript. Without specifics, all categories are potentially relevant, but the assignment is broad rather than strict.
semantic_rationale: The definition indicates a statement of author misconduct, which can encompass fabrication, falsification, plagiarism, or other ethical breaches. This directly impacts research content reliability, authorship integrity, editorial governance, and post-publication oversight. The investigation sources (journal, institution, etc.) are reflected in actor_context and process_signal.
